# Labels (create manually or via GitHub UI)

Recommended labels for triage:

| Label | Color suggestion | Use |
|-------|------------------|-----|
| `bug` | red | Defects |
| `enhancement` | blue | Features |
| `research` | purple | Research / eval |
| `pack` | green | Region Pack requests |
| `generator` | teal | Discovery generator work |
| `good first issue` | purple | New contributor friendly |
| `breaking-change` | orange | Requires RFC / minor bump |
| `needs-rfc` | yellow | Blocked on design record |
| `documentation` | grey | Docs only |
| `ci` | grey | CI / tooling |
